The '''Disciples of Shaa''' were an ancient group of [[Seylott (species)|Seylotts]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seylott/Legends|of the same name]]. They worshiped [[Shaa]], who they embodied in two statues, the [[Mother of Shaa|Mother]] and [[Infant of Shaa]]. The statues were closely guarded by the Disciples, who feared that if the power of the statue was unleashed, it could destroy an entire planet, earning it the name "Destroyer of Worlds".

Shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ashaar Khorda]] employed [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to retrieve the statue of the Infant. Khorda hoped to use the Infant's power to destroy or, from Ashaar's point of view, ''euthanize'' [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Succeeding in attaining the statue, Fett was convinced by his rival and contemporary [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] to return the statue in order to save Coruscant. After reattaining the statue, the bounty hunters returned it to the Disciples.
